inventory.name: Sit-up Shoot
inventory.description: Sit-up with explosive overhead ball/plate shoot at the top. HYROX core conditioning.

inventory.name: Sled Pull
inventory.description: Station 3 of 8. Pull a weighted sled 50 m (4 × 12.5 m lengths) hand-over-hand on rope, run to reset between lengths.
inventory.cues: Open men: +103 kg total (sled 50 kg + 53 kg added). Open women: +78 kg total. Hand-over-hand pull, athletic stance, big pulls > small pulls.

inventory.name: Sled drag (backwards)
inventory.description: Backwards sled drag with horizontal pull (TRX, harness, or rope). Knee-friendly quad development. Common ACC-block accessory for sled-push prep and quad mass.
inventory.cues: Distance: 4-6 × 20-40 m. Loads: 50-70% sled push race weight. Lean back into the pull, knees track over toes, short choppy steps. Goal: quad pump + tendon load, NOT cardio. Walk back recovery.

inventory.name: Assault Bike
inventory.description: Air/assault bike. Zone, calories and intervals set per block.

inventory.name: Atlas stone shoulder
inventory.description: Atlas stone lift to shoulder. Maximal-effort posterior-chain + odd-object lifting. Sandbag-clean carryover, full-body integration.
inventory.cues: Reps: 3-5 per set with reset between reps. Tacky on hands (or chalk). Stone between feet, hips down, lap → shoulder. Loads: 60-100 kg M / 40-80 kg W typical. High injury potential — only program when athlete has the lift in their movement library.

inventory.name: BikeErg
inventory.description: Concept2 BikeErg. Zone, distance/calories and intervals set per block.

inventory.name: Burpee to Plate
inventory.description: Burpee with jump onto/over a bumper plate. Used as inter-set conditioning filler.

inventory.name: Burpee Broad Jump
inventory.description: Station 4 of 8. 80 m of burpee broad jumps. Chest to floor each rep, two-foot takeoff and landing.
inventory.cues: Approx 40 reps depending on jump distance. Pace control critical — minute-after-minute consistency beats early heroics. Two-footed takeoff and landing are judged.

inventory.name: Sandbag clean
inventory.description: Floor-to-shoulder sandbag clean. Simulates HYROX sandbag-lunge setup and odd-object handling. Lower-body-driven hinge-pull.
inventory.cues: Reps: 5-8 per set. Loads: 20-40 kg M / 15-25 kg W. Hip-hinge to grip bag, lift with legs, transition through hip pop, catch on shoulder. Alternate shoulders set-by-set. Common ACC accessory before introducing race-distance sandbag lunges.

inventory.name: Run
inventory.description: Continuous or interval running. Zone, distance, pace and intervals are set per block.

inventory.name: Weighted pull-up
inventory.description: Pull-up with added load via dip belt + plate or weight vest. Vertical pulling strength, rope-pull / sled-pull carryover. Test metric for upper-body relative strength.
inventory.cues: Reps: 3-6 per set. Full range — chin over bar, dead hang at bottom. No kipping. Tempo 2-1-1-0. Loads: bodyweight + 0% to +30% for élite. Failed reps don't count. Stop set on first failed rep.

inventory.name: Sled Push
inventory.description: Station 2 of 8. Push a weighted sled 50 m (4 × 12.5 m lengths).
inventory.cues: Open men: +152 kg total (sled 50 kg + 102 kg added). Open women: +102 kg total. Low body angle, short choppy steps, never let the sled stop.

inventory.name: Banded Hip Flexion
aliases: flexion de cadera resistida con goma

inventory.name: Dip
inventory.description: Fondos en paralelas (peso corporal). Empuje vertical, complemento de tracción.

inventory.name: Weighted dip
inventory.description: Parallel-bar dip with added load. Vertical pressing strength, SkiErg finish carryover. Test metric for upper-body pressing relative strength.
inventory.cues: Reps: 5-8 per set. Full range — shoulders below elbows at bottom. Tempo 2-0-1-0. Loads: bodyweight + 0% to +30% for élite. Avoid if shoulder impingement history → swap for ring dips or close-grip bench.

inventory.name: Side Step Squat With Band
inventory.name_es: Paso lateral en sentadilla con banda

inventory.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
inventory.name_es: Peso muerto rumano a una pierna
inventory.description: Unilateral Romanian deadlift with DB or KB. Hip-dominant single-leg pattern, posterior chain + balance. Common HYROX accessory for sled pull / sandbag lunge support.
inventory.cues: Reps: 6-10/leg. Tempo 3-0-1-0 (slow eccentric). Hip hinge, knee soft, free leg back as counterbalance. No torso rotation — shoulders square. Loads typically 20-40% lower than bilateral RDL per hand.

inventory.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
inventory.name_es: Puente de glúteo a una pierna
aliases: puente de gluteo a una pierna

inventory.name: Rowing
inventory.description: Concept2 rowing. Zone, distance/calories and intervals set per block.

inventory.name: Pendlay row
inventory.description: Strict barbell row from dead-stop on the floor each rep. Horizontal pulling antagonist to bench/OHP. Builds posterior strength for sled pull and rowing.
inventory.cues: Reps: 4-6 per set typical. Bar starts on floor each rep (dead-stop). Torso parallel to floor, no body english. Pull to lower sternum / upper abs, NOT hips. Cargas tipo: 50-70% bench press 1RM as starting reference.

inventory.name: High Box Jump
inventory.description: Maximal-height box jump for reactive power. Distinct from standard Box Jump (sub-maximal).

inventory.name: SkiErg
inventory.description: SkiErg ergometer work. Zone, distance/calories and intervals set per block.

inventory.name: Breathing Work
inventory.description: Diaphragmatic / respiratory recovery work. Down-regulation and CO2 tolerance.

inventory.name: Farmers Carry
inventory.description: Station 6 of 8. 200 m carrying two kettlebells. No rest, no setting down (penalty if dropped outside designated zone).
inventory.cues: Open men: 2 × 24 kg KB. Open women: 2 × 16 kg KB. Tall posture, ribs down, fast turnover. Crush the handles, breathe rhythmically.

inventory.name: Run Technique Drills
inventory.description: Drills de técnica de carrera: skips, pogo, A/B skips, taloneo. Activación neuromuscular pre-carrera.

inventory.name: Wall Balls
inventory.description: Station 8 of 8. 100 reps (men) or 75 reps (women) of wall balls. Hip crease below knee at the bottom, ball must hit the target at the top.
inventory.cues: Open men: 6 kg ball, 10 ft (3.05 m) target, 100 reps. Open women: 4 kg ball, 9 ft (2.74 m) target, 75 reps. Break early, break often. Last station — empty the tank.

inventory.name: KB Overhead Walking Lunge
inventory.name_es: Zancada con kettlebell sobre la cabeza

inventory.name: Jump Lunge
aliases: zancadas con salto en el sitio

inventory.name: Sandbag Lunges
inventory.description: Station 7 of 8. 100 m of walking lunges with sandbag on back/shoulders. Trail knee must touch the floor each rep.
inventory.cues: Open men: 20 kg sandbag. Open women: 10 kg sandbag. Trail knee must kiss the floor (judged). Sandbag stays on back/shoulders. Approx 80-100 lunge reps.
